name: Mubert Cast
oneLiner: Audio-first editing and finishing tool for podcasts and spoken-word content — raw recording to publish-ready audio, without a DAW.

io.output: finished audio file; on supported plans, stems + transcript

audience.core: People and small teams making audio-first spoken-word content who want it polished without becoming audio engineers. They have something worth saying; audio production is necessary but not the goal.
types: Independent podcasters — solo hosts / small teams, interview, conversational, educational, narrative; edit it themselves
Experts, founders, consultants, personal-brand creators — podcasting to share expertise and build authority
Educators & knowledge creators — lectures, courses, lessons, long-form spoken content
Lean content teams — marketing/media producing spoken-word regularly without a dedicated engineer
lessSuitable: users who want manual sound engineering, not fast production

features.name: Royalty-free music for podcasts, lectures, audiobooks

differentiators: Transcript-based editing instead of waveform manipulation
Whole workflow in one place: transcript → content edit → cleanup → censoring → chapters → music → ducking → loudness → export
Music is generative and part of the product, not a stock library — one track reshaped into intro/outro/transition/bed, adaptive and editable
Music uses samples whose rights Mubert fully owns; commercial licensing on eligible plans
Built for creators, not audio engineers — automation and speed over manual DAW control
creditsNote: Credits are mostly for generated content (music, SFX), not ordinary editing. Verify the live pricing page before publishing any price/plan/offer.

prefer: Built into your podcast editing workflow
Royalty-free music for podcasts and spoken-word
Music from Mubert's fully controlled sample library
avoid: Impossible to receive a copyright strike

boundaries: No commercial rights to third-party music the user uploads
